title: SalaryCheck
description: What the statements say about a salary_net chain, derived on every read from the declarations, the eligible credits, statement coverage and fc-0.4 (ADR-049). Nothing here is stored. Evidence is tied to the expected payday of each pay month, not to the credit's calendar month. `numeric_effect` says whether the forecast uses the declaration (applied) or only keeps it for checking (saved_only); a declaration is never a credited salary.

status.description: declared: no match and no conflict. verified: at least one match. conflict: two consecutive eligible paydays without a match; it lasts until the user confirms a new version.

matched.description: Matches of the current version, counted from its effective_from.

missed.description: Eligible paydays without a match, counted from max(payday(effective_from), confirmed_at).

reasons.description: Why the effect is what it is; each code is also a warning of the financial tools that use memory.

version.description: The chain version that applies to this pay month.

outcome.description: not_eligible: the window payday ± 3 business days is not fully covered by verified, final statements, or has not ended; never a non-compliance, and it breaks consecutiveness. before_confirmation: no match, but the payday is before the version was confirmed, so it is not counted as missed.
